meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的具体缺陷,在全新临时工作区里做最小修复并验证。LazyCodex 自身的问题提交内嵌补丁的 issue;上游 Codex CLI 的缺陷则从 fork 提 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修 bug、提交 bug 修复,或为某个 LazyCodex / Codex 缺陷调试并提 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我修这个 bug,给 LazyCodex 提一个带补丁的 issue
say.note: 会先复现,再验证修复并提交 issue

say.text: 先复现这个缺陷,并写一个失败的回归测试
say.note: 之后做最小修复并跑验证命令

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex bug in a fresh temp workspace, makes the smallest fix and verifies it. LazyCodex defects become a verified-fix issue with the embedded patch; upstream Codex bugs become a fork PR.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or open a PR for a bug in LazyCodex or Codex.

say_en.text: Fix this bug and open a verified-fix issue for LazyCodex
say_en.note: It reproduces first, then attaches the patch.

say_en.text: This upstream Codex CLI bug: fix it and open a PR on openai/codex
say_en.note: It forks, pushes a branch and opens the PR.

say_en.text: Reproduce this defect and write a failing regression test first
say_en.note: Then it makes the smallest fix and runs QA.
